candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns 500; traces and logs show the order 500 preceding each checkout 502 within the same correlation IDs.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db pool, redis, downstream latency) is not established by gateway-only evidence.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s are consistently caused by order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders, as shown by correlated traces and logs. The specific order-side fault is not yet determined; order telemetry is required to bound it.
